text:
Maya: Quick sync — customers pushing for eval-triggered alerts + runtime recommendations (batching/caching/quant) so they can reduce cost without regressions.
Arjun: +1. Which metric will trigger alerts? precision drift or perf regressions?
Maya: Both. Proposal: eval alerts on delta-quality >= 3% or regenerate-latency > 2x baseline. Keep thresholds configurable per customer.
Sam: pilot with 2 customers makes sense. For recommendations we should surface: (1) batching knobs, (2) cacheable prefixes, (3) quant profile (int8/4-bit) + expected AUC loss estimate.
Priya: Need a minimal API shape — `POST /v1/optimize/suggest` returns list of recs with expected cost change and accuracy delta. Also need evaluation harness to simulate.
Maya: Agreed. Launch gates idea:
- acceptance: end-to-end integration with eval harness + docs
- stability: <1% false-positive alerts in pilot
- economics: >=20% median per-token cost reduction for at least 1 pilot customer
Arjun: Ops concerns: must include rollout fallback to host model on anomaly. Also rate limits on `/suggest` to avoid noisy loops.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy created for branch optimize-suggest v2 — status: pending
Sam: UX: recommendations should include confidence band, and a 'why' sentence. Example: "Enable batching=32 — expected +2.1x throughput, ~0.6% quality delta on prompts X"
Priya: For quant profiles we should show a small sample diff via the eval harness (side-by-side completions) and a link to the eval run id.
Maya: Ok action items: (1) Priya draft API + sample responses (2 days), (2) Arjun produce safe-fallback design + rate-limits (3 days), (3) Sam wire sample UX mock + minimal wording (2 days), (4) I'll set up pilot outreach to 2 customers and draft acceptance criteria doc (EOD Fri).
Arjun: I'll also add a metric in Console: "optimize.suggest.applied_rate" and an alert if applied_rate drops >50% post-change.
Sam: +1. Anything else before I spin up a tiny PoC to generate suggestions from existing logs?
Maya: No — go ahead. Keep it lightweight, use `--dry-run` flag. Ping here when you have the PoC link.
Priya: noting dependency: need eval harness token for sample runs. @Maya can you share?
Maya: shared in dm. :thumbsup:
Sam: got it. starting PoC now.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy for optimize-suggest v2 moved to staging at 1768555000
